Test Scenario: App closed on the gateway screen
Test Steps:
1. On the gateway screen (or in the e-wallet app), complete payment, then immediately force-close the marketplace app (swipe it away from recent apps).
2. Reopen the app and open My Orders.
Expected Result: The order shows To Ship once the gateway confirms. It is charged once only.

Test Scenario: Pay just before vs after the auto-cancel time
Test Steps:
1. Pay one order at 59 minutes.
2. Try to pay another at 61 minutes.
Expected Result: The 59-minute payment succeeds. The 61-minute order is already Cancelled and Pay is not available.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Pay in the e-wallet app and switch back
Preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. The e-wallet sandbox opens a wallet app or an in-app browser.
Test Steps:
1. Place an order for P-02 with the e-wallet.
2. Complete payment in the wallet app (or in-app browser).
3. Return to the marketplace app (automatic redirect, or switch apps by hand).
Expected Result: The app returns to the order, which shows To Ship with the payment reference and is charged once. When returning by hand, the order updates (after a pull-to-refresh at most) and Pay is not offered again.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Back button while payment is processing
Preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. An e-wallet order for P-02 is To Pay.
Test Steps:
1. Tap Pay and, while the processing indicator shows, press Android Back (or swipe back) twice.
2. Open the order.
Expected Result: The app asks before leaving, or ignores Back while processing. In the end the order is either paid once or still To Pay with Pay Again; never two payments or two orders.
